title: Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention for Conversational LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2512.06869v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models often lose track of persistent instructions and relevant information as multi-turn conversations grow. We study this cumulative contextual decay through three related failure modes: attention pollution, dilution, and drift. We propose REA(Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention), a context-management framework that assigns different persistence and representation policies to instructions and episodic interactions. Instructional Memory retains identified global constraints in a dedicated prefix. Episodic Memory preserves user inputs and compresses model replies, while heuristic retrieval selects raw text, compressed representations, or omission for each historical turn. On Long-MT-Bench+, REA improves the judge score from 6.32 to 7.36 on a 10-point scale, a 16.5% relative gain over the Vanilla baseline, and reduces average latency by 2.91x. translated_title: 面向对话式大语言模型的角色感知启发式情景注意力
translated_abstract: 随着多轮对话的不断增长，大语言模型往往会丢失对持久指令和相关信息的追踪。我们通过三种相关的失败模式来研究这种累积性上下文衰退：注意力污染、注意力稀释和注意力漂移。我们提出了REA（角色感知启发式情景注意力），这是一个上下文管理框架，为指令和情景交互分配不同的持久性与表示策略。指令记忆（Instructional Memory）在专门的前缀中保留已识别的全局约束。情景记忆保留用户输入并压缩模型回复，同时启发式检索为每个历史轮次选择原始文本、压缩表示或省略处理。在Long-MT-Bench+上，REA将评分从6.32提升至7.36（10分制），相比Vanilla基线相对提升16.5%，并将平均延迟降低2.91倍。额外的评估显示，在三个主干模型上均获得了总体性能提升。
tldr: 该论文提出REA框架，通过为指令和情景交互分配不同的持久性与表示策略来管理对话上下文，有效缓解多轮对话中的累积性上下文衰退问题，在Long-MT-Bench+上实现16.5%的相对评分提升并将延迟降低2.91倍。
en_tdlr: REA, a role-aware heuristic episodic attention framework that assigns distinct persistence and representation policies to instructions and episodic interactions, mitigates cumulative contextual decay in multi-turn conversations, achieving a 16.5% relative score improvement and 2.91x latency reduction on Long-MT-Bench+.
